item.title: ZIM workers escalate strike action over Hapag-Lloyd takeover
item.description: Workers at Israel’s flag carrier ZIM Integrated Shipping Services have escalated strike action following news of its planned $4.2bn sale to Germany’s Hapag-Lloyd. item.description: Dubai-headquartered maritime tech firm Marcura has acquired UK-based chemical tanker demurrage specialist Shipdem from its parent company, Casper Shipping. item.title: Fire claims two lives aboard Singapore-flagged bulker
item.description: An engine room fire on the Singapore-flagged bulk carrier Mandy has claimed two lives, with a third crewman airlifted to a hospital.
